name: meta-ads-superengine
description: Meta ads engine for coaches — strategy, creative, and ops from zero to a launched, scaling campaign. Run setup once, then get routed through the full journey: breakeven math before $1 is spent, qualified-signal infrastructure (Pixel + CAPI), compliance checked live, stage-appropriate campaign plans, voice-matched creative, disciplined testing, and read-only-first ops that talk you out of panic tweaks. Teach mode glosses both Claude terms and Meta jargon, so a first-time coach never hears an unexplained acronym — and an experienced operator can run everything terse. Never a dead end: every skill ends with your ranked next moves.
